verdict.rationale: AngelList is a SaaS platform for equity and fund management, so offering an official CLI is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official CLI: every documented workflow runs through the web dashboard. The llms.txt file on the help center is an AI-readable documentation index, not a CLI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
